top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the physiology and molecular identity of GLP-1 (incretin effect and proglucagon biology, identity of the active GLP-1(7-36)amide/(7-37) forms, receptor action), a mature chain from mechanism to patient confirmed in large randomized outcome trials for glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal risk. The citation is scoped to the discovery rather than drug optimisation, which makes the three-name credit defensible. Residual attribution doubts (Mojsov versus Habener priority, Knudsen's analogue engineering) are real but do not outweigh awarding a clearly deserving achievement over no award.
